The Blizzard Repair utility checks all files and tries to repair any that are broken. If you are still having problems running World of Warcraft, it is recommended that you reset the following settings:
Reset World of Warcraft third party custom interfaces
(Newer versions of third party custom interfaces need to be re-installed)
(Game settings, macros, and key bindings need to be re-configured)
Reset World of Warcraft cache data
(World of Warcraft makes a new cache)
NOTES: When the Blizzard Repair utility resets current settings, it makes backup copies of third party custom interfaces, configurations, and cache data in the World of Warcraft folder.
